neighbours.label: The split-off piece 'ulu'/'u' that ends a short name after its first letters (L|ulu, Z|ulu, S|ulu, Tut|u), vs names that are one token
fire: The novel was published through Lulu as a print-on-demand book.
Many Zulu songs are sung in call-and-response style.
Pirates once sailed the waters around the Sulu islands.
A speech by Desmond Tutu opened the conference.
My aunt named her parrot Lulu after a cartoon character.
The museum has a large collection of Zulu beadwork.
Ferries run from Mindanao to the Sulu archipelago.
Students read a short essay by Tutu on forgiveness.

predictions: Names whose tail is a separate 'ulu' or 'u' piece 0.6-0.9; single-token names and plain words under 0.05.
notes: Card: 'u' x11, 'ulu' x6, 'U' x4 in M|ulu|geta, LUL|U, L|ulu, P|ulu, Tut|u. Probe: Sulu 0.901, Tutu 0.830, Lulu 0.785, Zulu 0.668; Honolulu (one token) 0.000, Lily 0.002.
